newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Berger awarded projects worth S$43 mln.
newsitem.headline: Berger awarded projects worth S$43 mln.

text.p: Berger International Ltd said on Tuesday its wholly-owned subsidiary, Berger Contractor (S) Pte Ltd, has won contracts for two projects worth Singapore $43 million.
It said in a statement one project involved upgrading several blocks at a Singapore public housing estate in Kim Tian at a cost of S$21.7 million.
The other, worth S$21.7 million, is for the construction of a secondary school at Sengkang, the statement said.
It said Berger International's contracting business had grown strongly in the last two years and now accounted for about 32 percent of the group's turnover.
